Mario's look was not a fashion choice. It was a pixel problem.

In Donkey Kong, Shigeru Miyamoto had very few pixels to work with. Hair was hard to animate, so Mario wore a cap. A mouth was hard to show, so he got a mustache and a big nose.

Overalls made his arm movements readable. Those workarounds became the most recognizable face in gaming.
